name: Maintenance dispatch
summary: Takes a maintenance request logged in the property manager's job system, gets it approved and allocated to a maintenance person, keeps the tenant and owner informed, and tells the owner when the work is done. Crons read and draft; every allocation and every message to a person waits for approval.

covered_by.owner-approval: skill (the owner's go-ahead is the job moving to Work Order in ServiceM8)

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: New maintenance requests (jobs in Quote status) into the workflow store.

crons.name: dispatch
crons.summary: Work Order jobs with no allocation: queue the allocation to the default maintenance person for approval.

crons.name: follow-up
crons.summary: Track dispatched jobs, queue owner updates when a job completes, and queue a progress check when a job stalls (22:00 UTC is 8 or 9 am in eastern Australia).

draft_ops_note: Read operations only. Nothing this workflow reads is changed on the platform by a cron. The workflow store records what each run saw and queued.

servicem8.covers: request intake from Quote-status jobs, allocation of Work Order jobs to a staff member, job completion, and owner, tenant and progress messages

gaps: PropertyMe: its pages were read and it has no ops file in the kit, so no adapter. Needs its API mapped and a live account.
Tapi: its pages were read and it has no ops file in the kit, so no adapter. Needs its API mapped and a live account.
Console: a common platform with no platform docs or kit ops, so it is not built.
Owner approval: the owner's spend limit is not described on any page read. The workflow treats the job moving to Work Order in ServiceM8 as the approval. A person makes that move.
Triage: no urgency triage is described on the pages read. The skill handles it by hand.

Supplier choice: ServiceM8 allocates jobs to staff members, not to outside tradies. The workflow allocates to one default staff member from settings. Choosing a tradie per job needs a proposal command in the workflow runner.
Tenant access and appointments: not described on the pages read, and no ServiceM8 op is mapped for them here.
Invoice and payment: ServiceM8 can record payments, but the contractor invoice check and the owner payment step are not built. The payment op is not in live_ops.
Confirm the workflow steps and platform coverage with the business before enabling its crons.
Every adapter is docs-only until a ServiceM8 trial account proves the allocation and the message calls.
